name: CARRIED_BITS
quantity: 70, no use

name: CONTACT_BACK
quantity: 32 = CONTACT_BITS + FACE_BITS - COVECTOR_BITS (the host computes it)

name: HOLD_BITS
quantity: a hold's face on 2^-40; its named host twin is gone

name: MAX_CROWD_SLOTS
quantity: one warp; 2(ceil(log2 reach)-1) <= 32 iff reach <= 2^17

name: PACE_BITS
quantity: 24 (host = MATERIAL_BITS)

name: WINDOW_LIMBS
quantity: contact carriers to 8 limbs (512 bits) add in place

name: CONTACT_MIN_BLOCKS
quantity: 8 resident blocks a multiprocessor

name: SPREAD_THREADS
quantity: 256 a block of field_spread

name: MAX_PROBES
quantity: 127 probes keep the contact and reverse kernels' blocks an SM (ptxas -v, theory 00:25)

name: CONTACT_ROWS
quantity: 4 warps a contact block

name: REV_ROWS
quantity: 4 warps a reverse block

name: ENERGY_BITS
quantity: card twin

name: TERM_EXPONENT
quantity: 123 = 2*62 - 1: face and multiplier on 2^-62, the face's fraction 2^(f-1); the host's log_row writes 123 too

name: ENERGY_SUMS
quantity: 8 sums of 128 bits a region (pair on 2^-40, the rest on 2^-32)

name: RECORD
quantity: ASCII RS, the record separator

name: UNIT
quantity: ASCII US, the codec's unit separator

name: ENERGY_EPS_SHIFT
quantity: the attribution read's step 2^-4 of a letter's uniform weight

name: UNIT_BITS
quantity: the exponential navigator's unit (second declaration)

name: PUSH_BITS
quantity: pushes |beta| <= 2^2, the carrier's headroom

name: SQUARE_BITS
quantity: square law |h| <= 2^8, the carrier's headroom

name: LN2_BITS
quantity: ln 2's face 2^-30, the one ln2_face() releases to

name: FACE_BITS
quantity: a face: encodings E(a), letter faces z(a), class biases, ring faces
need: top place of |E|,|z| a section; bottom place moved of the face families

name: MATERIAL_BITS
quantity: the material theta (i32), and by identification the clocks (PACE_BITS), law (D)'s conditional p(v) and its weights, the coin's tau
need: top place of |theta| by family (i32 leaves 7 whole bits); bottom place moved of each family's step; least nonzero p(v) and the weight released below 2^-23

name: MOVE_BITS
quantity: decays D, rates b, phasors zeta, exp_series faces
need: bottom place of the released products; |zeta| stays <= 1

name: STATE_BITS
quantity: the tower's mode state (2^-24); not the field's STATE_BITS (16)

name: COVECTOR_BITS
quantity: the face families' covector
need: bottom place of the face families' covector

name: STEP_BITS
quantity: the tower deposit's covector grain and its epsilon

name: MARGIN
class: derived from a horizon, reason stale
quantity: moves' margin |lambda| <= 1-2^-12 (memory about 4,096 classes)
need: reason cites GSM8K's 520-byte problems; ceil(log2 3,771) = 12 restates it from today's longest region

name: READ_BITS
quantity: a code reading in bits, 2^-20
consumer: tower, split; in the field as the literal 20
need: written as 20 at 10 lines of the field and the energy (literals.tsv)

name: FIRST_RATE
quantity: first moment rate 2^-3

name: SECOND_RATE
quantity: second moment rate 2^-8

name: UNIT_BITS
quantity: the exponential navigator's unit 1 on 2^-62 (i64 less sign and one doubling)
consumer: tower, participation; declared also in keyed_modes, units, field.cu, tower.cu; literal 62 in skin_of, temperature_of

name: SHARE_BITS
quantity: a term's share of its row's mass, 1 on 2^-63 (u64 holding [0,1])
consumer: field release/round trips, energy log_row, lock_words, energy_faces
need: none: the share is <= 1 by construction

name: CONTACT_BITS
quantity: the contact covector dz, ds on 2^-40
consumer: tick_return, energy lock_words; host back = CONTACT_BITS+FACE_BITS+g-COVECTOR_BITS
need: card writes the derived 32 as the literal CONTACT_BACK

name: STATE_BITS
class: identity (= FACE_BITS by value, declared apart)
quantity: a site's carried face shares on 2^-16
need: name collides with the tower's STATE_BITS 24

name: NEAR
quantity: the near field, lcm(2,3) = 6, the solenoid's two finest rings

name: MAX_CLASS_TRITS
quantity: 3^7 = 2,187 classes within the card's 2^12 buckets a head and region
need: the bucket count is the card's

name: LN2_FACE_BITS
quantity: ln 2's face 2^-30; keyed_modes holds the same as LN2_BITS, untied

name: BLANK_HELD
quantity: = STATE_BITS

name: TEMPER_TOP
quantity: ceil(log2 T) <= 7 and T >= 2^-23: 31 - 24, the additive chart's 32-bit temperature its comment names; host and card now read T in 128 bits
need: the headroom it now stands for: top place of a covector times 1/T

name: LOCK_BACK_BITS
quantity: 2*16+1, the lock's covector read back

name: PACE_BITS
quantity: = MATERIAL_BITS: rate, clock and variation on 2^-24

name: WEIGHT_BITS
quantity: a source's and crowd's value multiplier 1 on 2^-62
consumer: row_bits, contact_return_bits, crowd_slots, tick, energy_cell, card

name: AVERAGE_RATE
quantity: averaged constitution's rate 2^-8 a section (= SECOND_RATE by value)

name: CHUNK
quantity: 16 places a read (16*alphabet configurations, about 0.8 GB)

name: ENERGY_BITS
quantity: Phi, G, log2 p on 2^-32; a fall is certified past slack = logs + logs' + 2 units
need: smallest certified fall about 2R 2^-32 bits for R logarithms read: count of ticks resting with the fall inside the slack, beside R

name: FIRST_HALVINGS
quantity: eta = 2^-2 at the first tick

name: MOST_HALVINGS
quantity: STATE_BITS + 8 = 24 halvings (the field's STATE_BITS, 16)
need: the 8 assumes |force| times scale below 2^8: print the top place of that product

name: COEFFICIENT_BITS
quantity: three faces on 2^-30: W on 2^-90

name: MOMENT_BITS
quantity: W times an encoding, 2^-106

name: RETURN_BITS
quantity: conj(zeta) D times a covector, 2^-84

name: RETURN_RELEASE_BITS
quantity: 84 - 24 = 60 released
